note: This challenge is a Skill-authoring task, not a paper reproduction. The 'deviations' below are a LOCAL SELF-TEST of the Skill on a bundled synthetic 3-page paper (examples/synth_paper.pdf, generated by examples/make_synth.py with known ground truth). They are not results on the hidden official cases and must not be read as benchmark scores. Run `python3 src/reproduce.py` to regenerate them (execution/results/selftest_summary.json).
